tasks.name: Shelf Skiff
tasks.description: Low gunboat on two broad ice runners.
tasks.design: SUBJECT: SHELF SKIFF, one small agile ground enemy. A compact low armored gunboat adapted to glide on snow: a short angular olive hull with a bone-cream wedge bow at the LEFT, two wide curved metal ski runners visibly touching the snow, a compact exposed triple muzzle mounted at the front, small flush sensor slit, rear thrust exhaust at RIGHT. Make the runners structurally convincing, connected by short fixed suspension brackets, not walking legs. Low sweeping hull and broad skis are its distinctive silhouette. Several ribbed cooling vents, tether cleats, worn ice-scraped bow, frost on the runner tips, dark panels beneath the cream cap. Do not make a tank, wheeled vehicle, walker, or hovercraft. Snow tracks and a small low snow plume can show its sliding motion; never hide the machine. Show exactly one skiff large in foreground on a continuous snow-covered coastal ice shelf. Fjord water clearly visible behind it. It should feel smaller and faster than a boss, with simple visible gun direction.
tasks.prompt:
Create an original richly detailed modern pixel-art concept illustration for Ember Drift, a side-scrolling phone game. This is a visual design proposal, not a gameplay screenshot or finished sprite. Use the attached APPROVED glacier-world image as the setting, light and palette reference: believable daylight glacier coast, layered ice cliffs, deep blue cracks, snow, distant jagged mountains, and visible teal fjord water with ice floes. The machine must dominate the composition and be clearly readable against the pale snow. 3:2 landscape image, full subject inside frame with generous margin. Mostly side-on, looking toward the LEFT, with only a slight three-quarter view to reveal construction. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, strong dark outlines and readable large shapes, dense panel detail, bolts, seams, worn paint, frost edges, mechanical joints. Muted olive-green and bone-cream armor over charcoal metal, small restrained amber warning lamps. Bright cold daylight with warm ivory sun highlights. Keep all machines original and visually in one coastal invader faction. No neon or neon glow, no photorealism, no blurry painting, no logos, no text, no labels, no UI, no hero, no player ship, no bullets, no battle explosions. No Star Wars or other franchise designs.

tasks.name: Anchor Gun
tasks.description: Exposed coastal cannon with broad anchor braces.
tasks.design: SUBJECT: ANCHOR GUN, one stationary ground enemy. A compact coastal cannon on a LOW dark rock ledge slightly above the snow, so its muzzle is visibly above the ledge and reachable from the left. One stout forward cannon barrel points LEFT from a small olive and cream armored housing. A distinctive three-way anchor-shaped metal brace grips the ledge with broad fixed flukes, not legs, and a short central swivel mount holds the gun. The anchor brace, round recoil collar, short heavy barrel and open armored hatch make a strong distinctive silhouette, quite different from a sled or flying drone. Show the two front cream armor plates opened to either side of a dark gun chamber, mechanical recoil rails, copper-colored heat vent and an amber warning lamp near the muzzle. No huge bunker, no tall tower, no wheels, no tracks, no articulated walking legs. Weapon fully exposed with open flying space to the left; no foreground ice hides any part. It sits in the foreground with snow-covered glaciers and teal water behind. Exactly one gun, centered and large. This is a small enemy emplacement, not a boss.

tasks.name: Twin Darts
tasks.design: SUBJECT: TWIN DARTS, a linked pair of compact flying combat drones. Exactly TWO identical original machines in separate clear air lanes, one above and slightly farther right than the other, with generous space between their silhouettes. Both point LEFT and each has a strong flattened diamond/kite shape: long sharp cream nose, broad swept olive side fins folding toward a charcoal central body, compact nose gun port, thin armored dorsal ridge, small amber sensor and rear engine at RIGHT. Their diamond planform must be readable in mostly side/three-quarter view; they should be thin fast attack drones, not passenger aircraft, X-wing craft, bird-shaped creatures, or copies of the existing hero. Add panel seams, hinge bearings on the folding wings, heat vents, frosted leading edges and small dark inset ports. One drone has its forward armor shutters OPEN to reveal the gun port, the other has shutters CLOSED; these are two firing states of the same design, not different enemy species. No firing shots, no glowing exhaust trail. Each drone occupies roughly one third of image width so all detail is clear. Both hover well above snow and fjord water; glaciers fill the distant backdrop. Do not put them on the ground or overlap them.

tasks.name: Breakwater — boss
tasks.description: Large armored ice vessel on three broad runners.
tasks.design: SUBJECT: BREAKWATER, the original giant BOSS of this proposed ice coast. A massive but LOW and LONG armored naval attack vessel that skates across snow on THREE broad smooth continuous ice runners. Near-broadside from slightly elevated three-quarter viewpoint so the third runner can be glimpsed on the far side. All runners contact the snowy ice, attached with short FIXED struts; absolutely NO walking legs, NO wheels, NO tank tracks, NO saw ring. This must be clearly unlike the Siege Crawler ground walker and the Glacier Warden saw boss. A powerful wide bone-cream wedge bow at LEFT serves as a snow plow; weathered olive upper decks step down into a charcoal armored hull, long sweeping naval lines, two recessed side drone-launch doors, and a COMPACT leaning rear exhaust tower at RIGHT, never a tall tank turret. Strong low naval silhouette and dynamic sense of a fast ice-skating vessel, not a static bunker. Its FRONT gun chamber at the bow faces LEFT: split armored shutters open to reveal deep dark machinery with a warm dull copper reactor/cooling assembly visibly reachable from the left. One broad forward volley weapon built into that chamber, heavy side plates, cooling pipes, heat vents, antenna stubs, thick riveted plow edges, snow caught on the top panels, ice-scored runner blades, and mechanical wear. There are no characters or other enemies in this picture. Show full boss large across the lower-middle of the image with snow trailing low behind; glacier cliffs and teal water make the scale convincing. Keep smoke and snow modest so every part is visible. No text, no hero, no bullets. This is one big boss, not a regular tank or multiple craft.
